snippet.title: Calamity Mod v2.0.4.001 Trailer | The Bountiful Harvest
snippet.description:
THE SUPREME CALAMITAS PLUSH IS HERE! | https://calamitymod.com/plush
Use code CALAMITYMOD15 for 15% off | Plushies only available until May 3rd!

-----------

Calamity's next feature-packed update is coming soon - the Bountiful Harvest! Tons of weapon reworks, new music, new boss resprites, many reworks to bosses and new Master Mode support are just a few of the headlines. Thank you all for your patience and sticking with us!
